events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Grand Haven pier: about 1 (below average).** It has the freshest pier report, and it's the one to try first.
- **St. Joseph pier: about 1 (below average).** Its latest pier report was slow, so I'd keep it as the backup.
- **South Haven and Muskegon: no rating.** Neither has a pier report in the last four weeks, so I can't say how the pier is doing there.
- **Lures at Grand Haven:** glow plugs and glow spoons. The last pier report says these worked, even though the bite was slow.
- **Expect a slow pier day.** If you want better odds, a boat fishing 50 to 90 feet down in 70 to 150 feet of water has been rated good.

## Why

- The Aug 16 Grand Haven report rated the pier slow (0), but noted that glow spoons and plugs worked well.
- The Aug 9 St. Joseph report called pier fishing slow, with only a few coho.
- I'd expect the pier to stay slow for now, because the buoy surface water warmed 4 to 9 F in the week before today, which suggests no fresh upwelling.
- Past late-August reports at similar water temperatures also rated the pier 1 (below average).

## Evidence

**Recent reports (newest Aug 16, six days old)**
- Grand Haven, Aug 16: pier anglers casting spoons found the bite "slow"; glow spoons and plugs "worked well" (quality 0). Boats did well: 40 to 90 feet down in 70 to 150 feet of water (quality 3).
- St. Joseph, Aug 9: "Pier fishing was a little on the slow side"; a few coho on nightcrawlers (quality 1). Boat anglers trolling around the pier heads caught mostly steelhead and a few coho.
- Grand Haven, Aug 2: pier rated 1; "a few salmon were caught on glow plugs."
- South Haven and Muskegon: boat reports only (South Haven Aug 16, Muskegon Aug 16), no pier data.

**Past seasons (history, similar surface temperature ~65 to 69 F)**
- Grand Haven, Aug 17, 2022: pier coho on shrimp and glow spoons, quality 1.
- Grand Haven, Aug 24, 2022: "the action was slow overall" at the pier (quality 1).
- St. Joseph, Aug 17, 2022: a few Chinook, "mostly all steelhead," on spoons and spinners (quality 1).

**Conditions now (weekly buoy summary, week before Aug 22)**
- St. Joseph: 71 F average, up 4 F over the week.
- South Haven: 66 F, up 9 F.
- Grand Haven and Muskegon: 65 F, up 5 F.
- The conditions tool returned a backtest summary, not live data, so I have no current wind forecast and no modeled pierhead water temperature.

## Caveats

- The newest report is six days old, and the season changes quickly in late summer.
- The buoy temperatures are measured but sit miles offshore. They show a warming trend, not pierhead water, so I can't confirm whether an upwelling is happening at the piers.
- Ratings for South Haven and Muskegon are unavailable because there's no pier data. Don't read that as good or bad fishing.
- The 1-rating for Grand Haven and St. Joseph is my estimate from one or two slow pier reports, not a measured rate.
- Check the DNR bulletin for this week and the wind before you go.

## Sources

- Grand Haven and Muskegon, Aug 16, 2023: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/36b27d5
- South Haven, Aug 16, 2023: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/36b27d5
- St. Joseph, Aug 9, 2023: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/369e344
- Grand Haven, Aug 2, 2023: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/368a51e
- Past seasons, Aug 17 and Aug 24, 2022: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3288194 and https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3298204
